title: record history: a dynamic-mode currency change still reads as a plain number, because the record page builds the History format context without the tenant currency
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ① user-visible display defect, an out-of-scope finding of PR #27638 (#27486), filed by the seat at review. Lands after PR #27638.

Blocked-by: #27486

## Business reason

Who: anyone reading Activity › History on a record whose currency field is `dynamic` mode (no code of its own, the tenant default applies). What happens once PR #27638 lands: a `fixed` currency change reads `$4,321,000.00` like the record page, but a `dynamic` one still reads as a plain grouped number (`4,321,000.00`) beside the record's `$4,321,000.00`, because the History tab is never handed the tenant's default currency.

## Where

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` ~L2443 (`origin/main`): `const fmtCtx = { t, locale: displayLocale, lookupLabels };` — passed to `formatAuditValue` for every change.
- PR #27638 adds the optional `tenantCurrency` member to `AuditValueFormatContext` (`utils/auditHistoryDisplay.ts`), read by `resolveFieldCurrency` as its last step (ADR-0053); the record page's cells already take it from `useLocalization().currency`.

## Acceptance

- The record page passes the tenant currency into the History format context (`tenantCurrency: useLocalization().currency` or the value the page's cells already read); a `dynamic` currency change reads with the tenant's code.
- A test on the record page's History tab drives a `dynamic` currency change. `record` mode stays a plain number (out of scope: its code is a sibling field).

## Reader who acts

The `domain:ui` seat holding `RecordDetailView.tsx` (seat 1's record-page chain, #25966) or the one triage names; one wiring line plus a test.

## reach

Public door: console record page › Activity › History on any object with a `dynamic` currency field, after PR #27638 lands (the card thread measured the gap in its report on #27486, comment 6501393530).

## Dedupe

Search API is unavailable from this session; read instead: the 500 most recently created issues (open and closed) by title, grep `tenantCurrency|history.*currency|dynamic.*currency` → 2 hits: #27486 (the parent, fixed/number/percent) and #27189 (currency docs page). No duplicate.
